status: BOUNDED DEVELOPMENT REVIEW; NOT A FABRICATION OR OPERATING RELEASE

kinematics.method: Closed-form circle/sphere intersection, separate from production Newton solver.
kinematics.grid: 81 roll values[-2,+2]deg;76 centre-heave values per roll within[-40+620|sin roll|,+35-620|sin roll|]mm;lateral[-3,0,+3]mm.
kinematics.scope: Independent lateral±3 remains a development probe. Retained locating/floating journal bearing lateral closure and all physical joint tolerances remain open; vertical travel admissibility is not operating approval.

equilibrium.method: Independent6×6linear equilibrium for[R1x,R1y,R1z,R2x,R2z,link], withR2y=0; compared against direct foundation formulas.
equilibrium.scope: Rigid-body arithmetic only; unknown maximum actuator output remains open.

support.scope: Geometric backing and fillet-toe space only; no joint strength or fatigue rating.

assembly.service: Wheelset out; remove selected axlebox, journal nut/retainers, then shop-remove one wheel. Slide closed rotor/hub/bearings past 110 nominal wheel seat using120 bore and split reducers. Actual press fit/removal and assembly procedure HOLD. No in-situ rotor replacement claim.
assembly.bearing_sleeve_retention: Separate split shaft clamps and abutments locate the reducer/inner-race stack; actual transverse bolts and axial head/tool holes are modeled. Fits, clamp preload, axial holding, creep and assembly procedure remain unqualified.
assembly.hub_axial_path: The shaft key pocket is closed atY369..393.572. The sleeve inboard pocket wall and outboard retaining plate capture the key axially, and two retaining plates capture the hub. This is a proposed key-end/retainer load path, not an ordinary key-torque or friction-clamp axial rating. End clearances, bearing stresses, screws, thermal growth and axle fatigue remain open.
